episode_summary: In this episode, Sam Burke shares his journey from a young real estate agent to a top producer, emphasizing the importance of maintaining high standards across all transactions. He discusses leveraging YouTube for lead generation, building strong client relationships, and investing in real estate as a young agent. Sam also highlights the power of visualization and consistent quality in building a successful real estate brand.
